translation_snapshot.source:
You see a mural showing a huge metropolis made of crystal, with small islands of stone floating in the air behind it. In the foreground is sitting a Sher'Tul, with a hand stretched up to the sky.
There is some text beneath

你看到一幅壁画，画中是一座巨大的水晶都市，后方有数座小型石质岛屿漂浮在空中。前景中坐着一名夏·图尔人，一只手伸向天空。
